component.name: Encore
component.summary: Ad-free music player for YouTube Music

description.p: Encore plays music from YouTube Music without ads and without tracking. No account is needed: everything you keep (likes, playlists, history, downloads) stays on your device. Or sign in to YouTube Music, optionally, for recommendations made for you and your library kept in sync.

ul.li: Search songs, videos, albums, artists and playlists, or paste a YouTube link
Song and artist radio, up next, shuffle, repeat and a sleep timer
Synced lyrics
Your own playlists, and import public playlists from YouTube Music, YouTube or Spotify
Downloads for offline listening
Optional YouTube Music sign-in: a home feed, mixes and radio made for you; liked songs, playlists, saved albums and followed artists kept in sync
Keyboard shortcuts and media keys

description.p: Encore is unofficial and not affiliated with YouTube or Google.
Fixes updating on Windows, and smaller cards on phones.

ul.li: Windows: Update now installs the new version and reopens Encore
Phones: smaller cards in Listen again and other scrolling rows, so more fit across

description.p: Optional YouTube Music sign-in: recommendations made for you, and your library kept in sync.

ul.li: Sign in to YouTube Music for a home feed, mixes and radio made for you (optional)
Liked songs, playlists, saved albums and followed artists stay in sync with your account
Save albums and playlists to your library, and follow artists
Add to playlist from the player, and Play something on Home
Age-restricted music videos play as their song version
Tap Search again to start typing; clear all recent searches

description.p: Update notifications, artist radio, faster downloads, and many fixes.

ul.li: Encore tells you when a new version is out (Flatpak updates itself)
An artist's Radio plays their own mix
Three songs download at once, and failures are reported together
The volume is remembered
History lists only songs you listened to
Shuffle can be turned off after a restart, with the original order back
Settings no longer stays on screen when you go to Home or Library

description.p: Themes, an equalizer, playback speed, and songs that follow each other without a gap.

ul.li: Six themes: Ember, Ocean, Forest, Orchid, Rose and Graphite
A five-band equalizer with presets
Playback speed from 0.5× to 2×
Search and sort in liked songs, history, downloads and playlists
Save the queue as a playlist, or clear it
Share songs, albums and playlists
Media controls and keys through the desktop (MPRIS)
The song in the window title, and the window reopens where it was
Works with screen readers on every screen

description.p: Your own playlists, playlist import from YouTube Music, YouTube and Spotify, a Videos search filter, and opening YouTube links.
